rootCauseAssessment: The product treats aggregate fact counts, object presence, and default non-bank branches as evidence for specific financial claims. It must gate every displayed claim on its exact dated inputs and business-model applicability.
generalBehaviorRequired: Implement metric-level evidence gating without changing thresholds to force a pass. (1) Valuation coverage must be calculated separately per valuation metric from dated metric observations; do not emit FULL, median, range, or percentile without that metric's qualifying history. (2) QGLP risk must require sufficient FERE evidence and cite FERE evidence before NO_RED_FLAG_DETECTED; FERE missing/partial must remain DATA_INSUFFICIENT. (3) QGLP leverage must use dated debt/leverage facts, not a non-bank default; BANK and NBFC must receive model-appropriate NOT_APPLICABLE or evidence-backed treatments. (4) UNKNOWN model must block model-dependent industrial analysis until verified classification exists. Preserve successful arithmetic and partial-source semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: New tests use a fresh disposable DB fixture and exercise real adapters/engines, not copied decision tables
Metric-level valuation history with one observation returns DATA_INSUFFICIENT/null statistics; multiple dated observations produce correctly computed median/range/percentile
QGLP with FERE DATA_INSUFFICIENT never says NO_RED_FLAG_DETECTED
QGLP leverage with absent debt evidence is DATA_INSUFFICIENT; BANK/NBFC behavior is explicitly model-aware
UNKNOWN business model does not emit industrial EBITDA-margin, cash-conversion or leverage conclusions
Existing 20-company arithmetic for revenue growth and non-financial EBITDA-margin bps remains correct
No migrations, ingestion runs, database writes, threshold tuning for the cohort, or changes to reviewer artifacts other than completion evidence
testsRequired: Targeted unit/integration tests for all four findings
Run the 20-company CAL_020 capture on a disposable current DB copy and report before/after production DB SHA or equivalent no-write evidence
regressionScope: FundamentalModuleAdapter, QglpModuleAdapter, ValuationIntelligenceEngine and their existing/targeted tests only
